app.name: Jagra
app.tagline: Tests Android builds before they go to QA.

env.title: Environment check
env.subtitle: Jagra uses the tools already installed on this computer. It never installs, updates or removes anything.
env.failed: The check could not finish. Press Check again.
env.untestedNote: An untested version can still be used. If something does not work, report the version with About > Copy info for bug report.
env.continueAfter: You can continue once {{tool}} is ready

problem.needs-java: It cannot start without Java 17 or newer, so fix Java first.
problem.timed-out: It did not answer in time.
problem.failed: It was found but did not run.
problem.too-old: Version {{version}} is older than Jagra supports.
problem.untested-version: This version is newer than the ones Jagra was tested with, and can still be used.

adb.name: adb
adb.title: Android platform tools (adb)
adb.why: Jagra uses adb to install the APK and talk to the device.

maestro.name: Maestro
maestro.title: Maestro
maestro.why: Maestro runs every flow, so a run cannot start yet.

emulator.name: Android emulator
emulator.title: Android emulator
emulator.note: Not needed when tests use a phone over USB
emulator.why: Without it, tests run on a phone over USB.

mockoon.name: Mockoon CLI
mockoon.title: Mockoon CLI
mockoon.note: Only for projects that use a Mockoon file
mockoon.why: Projects that use a Mockoon file cannot run without it.

java.install-jdk-17-or-newer: Install a JDK, version 17 or newer, for example Eclipse Temurin.
java.set-java-home: Set JAVA_HOME to the JDK folder, or add the JDK's bin folder to PATH.

adb.install-android-studio: Install Android Studio, which includes the Android SDK and adb.
adb.set-android-home: Set ANDROID_HOME to the Android SDK folder, or add its platform-tools folder to PATH.

emulator.install-from-sdk-manager: In Android Studio, open SDK Manager and install Android Emulator.
emulator.create-virtual-device: Create a virtual device in Device Manager.

maestro.install-java-first: Make sure Java 17 or newer is ready first. Maestro needs it.

windows.download-zip: Download maestro.zip from the Maestro releases page on GitHub.
windows.extract: Extract it to a folder that stays where it is, for example:
windows.add-to-path: Add this folder to PATH in the Windows Environment Variables window:

macos.run-install-script: Run Maestro's install script in Terminal:

maestro.check-again: Come back here and press Check again. Jagra does not need to restart.

errors.PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND: {{program}} was not found. Install it, or set its location in Settings > Tool locations.
errors.PROGRAM_IS_SCRIPT: {{program}} at {{path}} is a script, which Jagra does not start. Install the program itself.
errors.CONFIG_NOT_A_MAP: {{file}} must be a list of fields, such as "format: 1".
errors.CONFIG_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: {{file}} uses format {{found}}, and this Jagra reads format {{supported}}. Update Jagra.
errors.SECRETS_MISSING: These variables have no value: {{names}}. Add them in Settings > Secrets.
errors.NO_FLOWS: There is no flow to run. Add a flow first.
errors.RUN_SAVE_FAILED: The run could not be saved in {{folder}}.
errors.APK_NOT_FOUND: No APK was found in {{searchPath}}. Build the app, or choose an APK.
errors.APK_UNREADABLE: {{file}} could not be read as an APK.
errors.OUTPUT_MASK_FAILED: Maestro's output could not be checked for secrets, so it was not kept.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_AUTHORISED: Phone {{deviceId}} has not allowed USB debugging. Unlock it and accept the prompt.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_RESPONDING: Phone {{deviceId}} does not respond. Unplug it and plug it in again.
errors.EMULATOR_NOT_READY: Emulator {{name}} was not ready after {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.ADB_TIMED_OUT: adb {{command}} did not answer in time.
errors.INSTALL_FAILED: The APK could not be installed.
errors.PACKAGE_NAME_INVALID: "{{packageName}}" is not a package name. Check appId.
errors.INSTALL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH: {{packageName}} on the device was signed with another key and was kept.
errors.MOCKOON_PORT_MISSING: {{file}} has no port. Set mockoon.port in .jagra/config.yaml.
errors.MOCKOON_PORT_BUSY: Port {{port}} is already in use. The Mockoon desktop app may be open with the same port: stop that mock, or close the app.
errors.MOCKOON_NOT_READY: Mockoon did not answer on port {{port}} within {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.FLOW_HEADER_MISSING: {{file}} has no header. Start it with "appId:" and "---".
errors.FLOW_HEADER_NOT_A_MAP: {{file}}, line {{line}}: the header must be a list of fields.
errors.FLOW_APP_ID_MISSING: {{file}}, line {{line}}: the header has no appId.
errors.FLOW_PROPERTIES_INVALID: {{file}}, line {{line}}: "properties" must be a list of fields.
errors.FLOW_STEP_INVALID: {{file}}, line {{line}}, is not a Maestro step.
errors.FLOW_AI_COMMAND: {{file}}, line {{line}}, uses {{command}}, which lets an AI decide the result. Jagra does not run it.
errors.FLOW_HELPER_NOT_FOUND: {{file}}, line {{line}}, calls {{helper}}, which does not exist.
